messages.checkpoint_verified: The review screen and requested outputs were verified.
messages.validation: The application rejected one of the entered values.
messages.permission: The application denied access. An operator needs to review the session.
messages.session_expired: The session expired. Restore it before continuing.
messages.unknown_dialog: An unexpected confirmation needs an operator's review.
messages.checkpoint_timeout: The expected screen did not load in time.
messages.handoff_timeout: The run stopped while waiting for operator help.
messages.target_missing: A required control could not be found on the page.
messages.ambiguous_target: More than one control matched. The run stopped to avoid choosing the wrong one.
messages.profile_drift: The application no longer matches the configured profile.
messages.profile_mismatch: This capability does not match the configured application profile.
messages.invocation_mismatch: The review details do not match the requested member or nickname.
messages.invalid_output: A returned value did not match the capability's output format.
messages.invalid_input: Check the required input fields and their values.
messages.worker_busy: Another run is still active. Finish or stop it before starting a new one.
messages.resume_checkpoint_rejected: The page is not ready to continue. Repair the issue shown above, then try again.
messages.stale_control: This control claim is no longer valid. Check who currently owns the session.
messages.irreversible_blocked: Account submission is blocked in this runtime.
messages.model_blocked: The model could not choose a safe next action.
messages.model_credentials_missing: Set up the selected model connection before running discovery.
messages.model_transport_failed: The model connection could not be started. Check the CLI path and login.
messages.model_request_failed: The model request failed. Check the selected connection and account.
messages.discovery_dead_end: Discovery repeated the same decision and stopped for review.
messages.manual_discovery_requires_rerecord: This discovery needed manual steps. Record a new run before saving a reusable capability.
messages.run_not_found: This run is no longer available. The server may have restarted.
messages.artifact_required: Choose a saved capability before replaying.
messages.run_timeout: The run reached its time limit.
messages.step_limit: The run reached its step limit.
